data.name: Lasthold
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

The island is overrun.

After chasing a group of thieves to recover your father's stolen boat key, you find yourself trapped on an island consumed by the undead. Escape won't come easily—you'll have to survive, rebuild, and fight your way through relentless zombie hordes while searching for a way off the island.

Lasthold is a 2D pixel-art side-scrolling zombie survival shooter that combines fast-paced action with strategy, resource management, farming, and exploration.

During the day, gather supplies, harvest crops, earn Food Points, purchase weapons and ammunition, reinforce your defenses, and prepare for what's coming. As night falls, waves of zombies attack from every direction. Every bullet counts, every decision matters, and every night survived brings you one step closer to escaping the island.

Explore new unique locations, uncover new equipment, unlock powerful weapons, complete story-driven objectives, and slowly reveal the mystery behind the outbreak.

Can you survive long enough to make your final stand?

FEATURES

  • Defend your base against relentless zombie hordes.

  • Shoot, survive, and manage your resources wisely.

  • Grow crops to earn Food Points and fund your survival.

  • Buy weapons, ammunition, medical supplies, and equipment.

  • Unlock powerful firearms and defensive upgrades.

  • Complete story missions and uncover the truth behind the outbreak.

  • Cute pixel-art visuals packed with satisfying zombie action.

  • Strategic progression where every day makes you stronger for the nights ahead.

Survive. Prepare. Defend.

Then make your last hold... and escape.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
